sources.title: The proximal origin of SARS-CoV-2
sources.supports: Conclusions on genome features and laboratory scenarios.
sources.limitations: The paper is an argument based on available evidence, not an audit of laboratories.
sources.review: Indexed article text; direct publisher fetch redirected.

sources.title: WHO-convened global study of origins of SARS-CoV-2: China Part
sources.supports: The joint team's original hypothesis rankings.
sources.limitations: Distinguish the joint team from subsequent WHO leadership statements.
sources.review: Publication page and corroborating WHO statements reviewed.

sources.title: Director-General's remarks on the origins report
sources.supports: Tedros challenged the adequacy of the laboratory assessment on publication day.
sources.limitations: Does not establish a laboratory origin.
sources.review: Full relevant statement reviewed.

sources.title: COVID-19 virtual press conference
sources.supports: Tedros described premature reduction of consideration of the laboratory hypothesis.
sources.limitations: Criticism is not a quantified replacement probability.
sources.review: Relevant transcript passage reviewed; printed page 10.

sources.title: Statement on advancing the next series of origins studies
sources.supports: WHO said evidence was insufficient to exclude hypotheses after review.
sources.limitations: Does not state equal probability for all hypotheses.
sources.review: Full relevant statement reviewed.

sources.title: SAGO preliminary report
sources.supports: Recommendations for additional laboratory investigations.
sources.limitations: Recommended investigations are not completed investigations.
sources.review: Relevant indexed passages reviewed.

sources.title: Independent assessment of the origins of SARS-CoV-2
sources.supports: Assessment of available evidence, missing records, laboratory access and government reports.
sources.limitations: Conclusions are attributed to SAGO; this project has not independently reproduced its scientific review.
sources.review: Relevant sections reviewed, especially printed pp. 37–39, 44 and 57–58.

sources.title: WHO scientific advisory group issues report on origins of COVID-19
sources.supports: WHO's public summary of the 2025 assessment.
sources.limitations: Evidence favouring zoonosis and unresolved laboratory assessment must both be represented.
sources.review: Full relevant announcement reviewed.

sources.title: WHO COVID-19 Global Risk Assessment, version 10
sources.supports: Continued unresolved origin and best-supported zoonotic hypothesis.
sources.limitations: Publication date is 6 August; assessment covers information through 30 July 2026.
sources.review: Landing page and PDF virus-origins section reviewed.

sources.title: WHO global framework for studies into pathogen origins
sources.supports: Guidance includes investigating possible biosafety/biosecurity breaches.
sources.limitations: This is the editorial republication date; the framework existed in 2024. It is not proof that all recommendations were implemented.
sources.review: Publication overview and editorial-update note reviewed.

sources.title: Joint statement on the WHO-convened COVID-19 origins study
sources.supports: Calls for access, timeliness and independent investigation.
sources.limitations: Criticism of process does not resolve origin.
sources.review: Full relevant statement reviewed.

sources.title: Investigate the origins of COVID-19
sources.supports: Scientists called for balanced, transparent investigation and conflict management.
sources.limitations: A call for research is not proof of either hypothesis.
sources.review: Author-hosted text reviewed.

sources.title: NIH and EcoHealth did not effectively monitor awards and subawards
sources.supports: Monitoring and reporting failures, agency responses and EcoHealth disagreements.
sources.limitations: The audit did not adjudicate experimental science or establish pandemic causation.
sources.review: Full executive summary and responses reviewed.

sources.title: Determination of WIV debarment
sources.supports: Ten-year debarment and failure to provide required research records.
sources.limitations: Uncontested administrative determination, not a criminal judgment or pandemic-origin finding.
sources.review: Determination reviewed, including signature date and end date.

sources.title: Notice of EcoHealth Alliance debarment
sources.supports: Five-year debarment, counting suspension time, through 14 May 2029.
sources.limitations: Historical notice; current legal status should be checked for later decisions.
sources.review: Notice reviewed.

sources.title: Notice of Peter Daszak debarment
sources.supports: Five-year debarment, counting suspension time, through 20 May 2029.
sources.limitations: Historical notice; not a finding that he caused the pandemic.
sources.review: Notice reviewed.

sources.title: Director-General's remarks on delayed market data
sources.supports: WHO criticised the delayed release of Chinese CDC market-sample data.
sources.limitations: Missing data affect investigation of animal as well as laboratory origins.
sources.review: Full relevant statement reviewed.

sources.title: Addendum: competing interests and the origins of SARS-CoV-2
sources.supports: Expansion of Peter Daszak's competing-interest disclosure.
sources.limitations: Published June 2021; journal issue dated 26 June–2 July. Disclosure does not itself prove scientific misconduct.
sources.review: Indexed text and publisher abstract; direct full-page retrieval blocked.

sources.title: Release of report on Proximal Origin
sources.publisher: US House Select Subcommittee, Republican majority
sources.supports: Documented public release containing Slack messages.
sources.limitations: Used for provenance; the committee's accusations are not adopted as adjudicated facts.
sources.review: Dated announcement reviewed.

sources.title: The Proximal Origin of a Cover-Up: interim majority staff report
sources.publisher: US House Select Subcommittee, Republican majority
sources.supports: Contemporaneous publication of message excerpts.
sources.limitations: Separate reproduced messages from the report's interpretation; a complete message audit remains outstanding.
sources.review: Indexed message passages and report date reviewed.

sources.title: Covid Origins Scientist Denounces Reporting On His Messages As A Conspiracy Theory
sources.supports: Publication of a larger Slack and email collection.
sources.limitations: Full cache describes what the publisher released, not every message ever sent. Its misconduct claims need independent evaluation.
sources.review: Accessible article and download-link labels reviewed; complete PDF not compared.

sources.title: Announcement of Proximal Origin Slack release
sources.publisher: Senator Rand Paul / Senate HSGAC majority
sources.supports: Dated later release announcement.
sources.limitations: Overlap with the 2023 collection has not been established; some reporting uses 21 July.
sources.review: Dated announcement reviewed; complete files not compared.

sources.title: WHO report suggests likely zoonotic origin, doesn't rule out lab leak
sources.supports: Secondary-source support for a neutral Wikipedia update.
sources.limitations: Online date 25 July; issue date 26 August 2025.
sources.review: Visible summary reviewed.

sources.title: COVID-19 lab leak theory
sources.supports: Object of editorial review: lead and WHO assessment section.
sources.limitations: Retrieved page may be cached; oldid 1383318750 exposed by permanent-link control, but pinned-page fetch timed out.
sources.review: Retrieved article reviewed; permanent-link target recorded.

sources.title: Origin of SARS-CoV-2
sources.supports: WHO Phase 2 chronology and current presentation.
sources.limitations: Observation is about this revision, not all future versions.
sources.review: Pinned revision reviewed; edited 11 November 2026.

sources.title: The proximal origin of SARS-CoV-2
sources.supports: Attribution of the paper's conclusions and reference to the 2023 disclosure.
sources.limitations: Object of review, not independent proof of scientific claims.
sources.review: Pinned revision and retrieved article reviewed.

sources.title: Democratic staff findings on EcoHealth compliance
sources.publisher: US House Select Subcommittee, Democratic minority
sources.supports: Concerns about possible misrepresentations alongside rejection of causal allegations.
sources.limitations: Potential misconduct is not a final adjudication.
sources.review: Statement reviewed.

sources.title: Call for editorial action on Proximal Origin
sources.supports: Documents a request for an expression of concern and retraction review.
sources.limitations: Advocacy is evidence that a demand was made, not that the demand is scientifically justified.
sources.review: Indexed letter text reviewed; exact publication date not verified.
